lines.en: Upside down, I crawl feet to the sky.
The ceiling is my floor.
My fingers hook the wooden beam.
I shuffle forward hanging inverted.
Directly beneath me is your head.
The boards creak under me.
I creep along the ridge beam.
Hanging inverted, I'm actually steadier.
My shadow falls at your feet.
My eyes see the world from below.
I cling to the corner beam.

lines.zh: 一点灰落下来，你抬头了吗
lines.en: A little dust falls. Did you look up?
I hang inverted, without moving.
Quieter than a corpse.
My hair hangs down, swaying.

lines.zh: 我在等一个走进来的人
lines.en: I wait for someone to walk in.

lines.zh: 屋里的灰落在我的脸上
lines.en: Dust settles on my face.

lines.zh: 我把手指一根根松开又扣紧
lines.en: I loosen and tighten my fingers one by one.

lines.zh: 天花板上只有我的呼吸声
lines.en: Only my breathing on the ceiling.

lines.zh: 下面有人走动，我听得见
lines.en: Someone walks below. I hear it.
My hide sags down from my back.
Upside down, this room looks foreign.
If I don't move, I won't be seen.
I count the ceiling beams.

lines.zh: 有什么声音从门口传来
lines.en: Some sound comes from the doorway.
I turn my head slowly downward.
The corner light is dim. Good.
I'm very patient.
The roof is my bed.
I hang like an empty sack.
I look down at you, from above.
You haven't looked up. A shame.

lines.zh: 我的脸正对着你的后颈
lines.en: My face is level with your nape.
You came in. Leave the door be.
I tilt my head, hair hanging down.
Only the two of us in this room.
Did you hear something above?

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，也没什么可眨
lines.en: I don't blink. Nothing left to blink.
Look up and I'm right there.
This close, you can't run.

lines.zh: 我的手已经松开一根指头
lines.en: I've let one finger go.
We're both waiting for the other to move.
I swing wildly and grab the beam.
Dust and splinters fall on my face.
One finger slipped.
The pain makes me suck in a breath.
A new tear in my hide.
Hanging inverted, I can't dodge well.

lines.zh: 这一下让我整个身子晃起来
lines.en: The blow sets my whole body swinging.
I spit out black fluid.
Now you know where I am.
Then let's be quick about it.
What are you holding up down there?
I smell it, from up here.
Food doesn't pull me while I hang.
That means nothing to rotten flesh.
Lift it higher; I can't see.
I let one hand drop to test.
Leave it. I won't come down for it.
The higher you hold it, the more I want to drop.
I tilt my head and drool falls.
Put it on the table and back away.
You hit my leg and finally look up.

lines.zh: 我倒挂着被你顶了一下
lines.en: Hanging there, I take your shove.
I swing twice before settling.
I grip the beam. I don't fall.

lines.zh: 你的头撞上了我的膝盖
lines.en: Your head met my knee.

lines.zh: 我身上的皮蹭到你的脸
lines.en: My loose hide brushes your face.

lines.zh: 这一撞让你离我更近了
lines.en: That bump brought you closer.
I drop half a foot lower.

lines.zh: 你退了，屋顶却在我这边
lines.en: You retreat, but the roof is mine.
Bump me again and I let go.
Two shadows hanging inverted.
This beam is wide enough. Come over.
We'll hang back to back.

lines.zh: 我挂在你头顶，倒着看你。
lines.en: I hang above you, watching upside down.
We wait for the same door.
I'm not much good at talking upright.
But I can wait for you indefinitely.
When the dust falls, don't move.

lines.zh: 这屋子太小，容两个人正好
lines.en: This room is small — just right for two.
We'll swap places after dark.
I free one hand and reach down.

lines.zh: 东西掉在地上，我够不着
lines.en: It's on the floor. I can't reach.
I hook it up with my toes.
Picking things up inverted is awkward.
I pinch it between my fingers.
This can hang off me.
I take it up in my teeth.

lines.zh: 你掉的，正好落在我下面
lines.en: You dropped it right beneath me.
It dangles from the beam. No trouble.
Put away. I'll eat later.
You finally came inside.
Three of my fingers have let go.
Target directly below.
I've measured this drop.
Looking up won't help now.
I can't hold on much longer.
The beam is my launch point.
Stop moving and I come down.
This room has no second door.
Let's make a pair, you and I.
I coil back slowly to load up.
You've moved to the table. Good.
Another finger loosens.
I'm aiming at the top of your head.
You still won't look up.
Two steps more and you're directly beneath.
My body swings.
I wait for the dust to settle.
Do you hear the roof creaking?
Now. I'm letting go.
I drop onto your back.
This fall, I don't intend to survive.
What's under my hide is swelling.
You're pinned and can't lift your head.
I wrap my arms around your shoulders.
Dust bursts through the room.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣进你的护甲缝
lines.en: My fingers dig into your armour's seam.
The room is too small to dodge.
I drive you toward the wall.
Time's up. Together, then.
I take shape on the beam.
A muffled thud comes from the roof.
I hang inverted, watching the door.

lines.zh: 这间屋子的天花板归我
lines.en: This room's ceiling belongs to me.
Dust falls from the beam.

lines.zh: 我数着这屋子有几个入口
lines.en: I count the room's entrances.
No one has noticed me up here yet.

lines.zh: 我的头发垂到门框那么低
lines.en: My hair hangs as low as the door frame.
I came down through the roof.
People here don't look up.
I see this world upside down.
Waiting for a door to open.

lines.zh: 火从下面烧上来，我烫得松手
lines.en: Fire climbs from below; the heat makes me let go.

lines.zh: 我摔在木板上，骨头散了
lines.en: I crash onto the boards and something breaks.

lines.zh: 水漫上来，我倒着呛进去了
lines.en: Water rises and I choke on it upside down.

lines.zh: 气浪把我从梁上掀下来
lines.en: The blast peels me off the beam.

lines.zh: 箭从下往上钉在我胸口
lines.en: An arrow drives up into my chest.
That light makes me lose my grip.
Too starved to grip.

lines.zh: 雷穿过屋顶，我浑身一颤
lines.en: Lightning through the roof makes me convulse.
I fall; the roof is gone.
